name: Hornero Emoji
description: Emoji search in the launcher (>emoji) and an emoji picker card over the bundled Unicode 16.0 table. Local only: no history, no network, your skin tone and result count are settings.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: >emoji launcher provider (several rows, Enter copies) and a dashboard picker over Unicode 16.0 names. Needs the Hornero Shell with multi-row launcher results; older shells keep the dashboard card and skip the launcher provider.

skinTone.description: Skin tone applied to emoji that have tone variants (people, hands).

maxResults.description: How many emoji the launcher and the card list at most.

showGroup.description: Show the emoji group (for example Animals & nature) next to the name.
